comments.text:
To me, “Zombie” voiced an uncomfortable truth: violence was stripping people on both sides of their humanity. How do you face what you’ve become when admitting it feels like losing face?

A timeless cry for peace. Emotional. Legendary.

May no mother’s heart ever break again because another life was taken.

RIP Dolores O’Riordan.
You gave that pain your voice. It still echoes. ☮️
